style.name: Shaker Contemporary
style.definition: Useful timber furniture, modest proportions and precise craftsmanship with contemporary comfort.

style.living: cream upright sofa on cherry legs; cherry woven-seat armchair; rectangular cherry coffee table; cherry paneled media cabinet; compact cherry table with four ladder-back woven-seat chairs; simple cream dome pendant

style.implement: Choose visible joinery and practical drawers; let proportion supply the decoration.
style.avoid: Avoid faux barn doors and rustic clutter.
